impact: No deal keeps the oil risk premium and Hormuz uncertainty in place, which feeds inflation and the yield pressure on NBIS, BE, PLTR and MU; avoiding renewed war limits the downside.
source: Middle East Monitor / The New American
summary: Trump said on Truth Social he was done trying to reach a deal with Iran and told Vice President JD Vance to focus on other issues. A Nov. 14 report says he does not want to resume the war with Iran for now, while his administration keeps economic and military pressure on Tehran.
title: Trump says he's done seeking an Iran deal but won't resume war 'for now'
